High-level ask: 30 min product demo with a 15 min business/contract check (procurement + exec sponsor).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Nov 30 — 11:00–11:45
- Wed Dec 1 — 08:30–09:15 (early for your EMEA folks)
- Thu Dec 2 — 15:00–15:45

Thanks — Ben

Ben — thanks. All three windows look workable for the core Eng team. Two quick asks from procurement/security:

2) Our security lead wants a copy of your latest SOC 2 report and a short call with your security engineer — can we fit a 20-min pre-demo security sync the week before?

Marc (cc) can confirm VP availability — Marc, are you able to join one of Ben's proposed slots? If not, share two alternatives.
